motion.name: button-feedback
motion.purpose: Brief color and press feedback on primary actions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Minimize interface transitions when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--forest, #17372e); border-radius: 3px; color: #fff; background: var(--forest, #17372e); font: 700 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #245542; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #e98770); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: Secondary text action for refresh and row controls.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; color: var(--forest, #17372e); background: transparent; font: 650 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #e98770); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-quiet:active { color: #102b24; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #1a2d25; font: 650 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #c8d5c9; border-radius: 3px; color: #1a2d25; background: #fff; font: 400 15px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #8ba995; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e98770; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Current Navigation Link
components.description: Workspace navigation link with a visible current state.
components.css: .ds-nav-current { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 3px; color: #102b24; background: #82c877; font: 600 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-current:hover { background: #9bd58f; } .ds-nav-current:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e98770; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-current:active { background: #6dbb63; }

components.name: Link Status
components.description: Compact active or disabled state in the link ledger.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #2c6941; font: 600 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status::before { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #82c877; content: ""; } .ds-status:hover { color: #17372e; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e98770; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: LinkPulse uses the visual language of a practical field notebook: fern ink, leaf-green markers, a pale working surface, and small pollen and coral signals. It is direct and task-oriented, with the supplied Teddy animation providing the distinctive character rather than decorative interface chrome. The ledger favors open sections, fine dividers, readable measurements, and a compact status vocabulary. The interface stays grounded in real workspace data; empty states are explicit and never filled with invented activity.
keyCharacteristics: Forest green anchors navigation and primary actions.
Leaf green marks active states; pollen and coral are reserved for small signals.
Links and traffic use aligned, unboxed rows and a simple daily line chart.
The supplied Rive animation is served locally and respects reduced motion.

rules.name: The Working-Measure Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for counts and keep labels short; do not dress ordinary UI text in a technical mono face.

rules.name: The Field-Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate working regions with tonal surfaces or dividers, not stacked shadow cards.

dos: Do use the supplied Teddy Rive file locally, with the Teddy artboard and Login Machine state machine.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and show a useful fallback if animation loading fails.
Do label analytics as recorded and keep bot-exclusion semantics visible.
Do render user/API content as text, not injected HTML.
donts: Don't invent traffic, destinations, or workspace data.
Don't treat a disabled link as deleted; preserve its reportable state.
Don't add card grids, rounded dashboard tiles, or decorative shadows that compete with the ledger.
Don't imply the browser needs a third-party API key; requests are same-origin.
